ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child has found a shortcut to the beach that takes much longer and is very muddy, and is extremely proud of it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has found a shortcut to the beach. It goes over a fallen log, under some bushes, round a big rock and through a patch of mud. It takes much longer than the normal path, and (subject) arrives covered in leaves and mud. (subject.He/She) is extremely proud of it.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) leads (friend) along the shortcut. (friend) gets stuck under the bushes, slips in the mud, and arrives at the beach looking like a swamp creature. "Isn't it quicker?" says (subject). (friend), picking a leaf out of (friend.his/her) ear, decides that it doesn't matter whether it's quicker. It was definitely more interesting.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) tells nobody about the shortcut. It's (subject.his/her) own. Every day (subject.he/she) takes it to the beach, and every day (subject.he/she) arrives late and muddy, and every day the grown-ups wonder why. (subject) never explains. A child has to have some secrets.
